queries.sql:
SELECT r.RUN_ID, r.WORKSPACE, r.PREDECESSOR_RUN_ID, r.MODE, r.STATE, r.CONTENT_HASH, TO_VARCHAR(r.CREATED_AT) AS CREATED_AT, s.SNAPSHOT_ID, s.LABEL
    FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.CONSOL_RUN r LEFT JOIN SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.CONSOL_SNAPSHOT s ON s.RUN_ID = r.RUN_ID ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT, r.RUN_ID
SELECT CONFIG_SET_ID FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.CONSOL_RUN_CONFIG WHERE RUN_ID = 'RUN-AXADED3-20261121204752-V2-3'

SELECT APPROVAL_ID, STAGE, RUN_ID, PACKAGE_ID, DECISION, USER_ID, ROLE_ID, NOTE, TO_VARCHAR(APPROVED_AT) AS APPROVED_AT FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.CONSOL_APPROVAL WHERE RUN_ID IN ('RUN-AXADED3-20261121204752-V2-3','RUN-AXADED3-20261121204752-V1', 'CHAIN-20261121204752') ORDER BY APPROVED_AT

SELECT RUN_ID, JOURNAL_KEY, RULE_ID, RULE_VERSION, FAMILY, POSTING_LEVEL, ORIGIN_ENTITY, PARTNER, DESCRIPTION, TO_JSON(CALC) AS CALC FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.CONSOL_JOURNAL WHERE RUN_ID IN ('RUN-AXADED3-20261121204752-V2-3','RUN-AXADED3-20261121204752-V1') ORDER BY JOURNAL_KEY

SELECT RUN_ID, ENTITY_ID, ACCOUNT, ACCOUNT_NAME, ACCOUNT_TYPE, SECTION, IS_CASH, PARTNER, FLOW, LEVEL, FAMILY, RULE_ID, JOURNAL_KEY,
